title: Aadhya Self Drive — Flutter iOS & Android
lead: Cross-platform mobile app for Aadhya Self Drive — a self-drive car rental service. stackcone built and shipped the Flutter app on iOS and Android; Aadhya Self Drive is an active stackcone client.
requirements: Browse and book hatchback, sedan, and SUV rentals for hourly or daily use
Secure in-app document upload for renter verification
Owner portal for fleet operators to manage vehicles and bookings
Transparent pricing, payments, and customer support from the app
implementation: Flutter app for iOS and Android from a single codebase
Booking flow with location-based search, flexible rental durations, and trip management
TestFlight and Play Store release pipeline with store listing assets and version updates
Monetization through in-app booking and payment flows tied to the rental backend
outcome: Live on the App Store and Google Play with 1K+ Android downloads and 5-star iOS ratings. Client site at aadhya.icu — ongoing stackcone engagement.

title: CabinetSense — SaaS platform & RAG assistant
lead: Commercial SketchUp cabinet-design SaaS with a Java App Engine cloud platform, support operations dashboard, and a Python Cloud Run RAG service with multi-LLM routing.
requirements: Support team needed Kanban and list views for tickets with role-scoped access
Embedded AI chat inside SketchUp with usage-based billing and credit tracking
Multi-stage RAG over a knowledge base with streaming responses and admin telemetry
implementation: Refactored support board from JSP to lazy JSON APIs with batch Datastore loads
FastAPI RAG on Cloud Run: Pinecone retrieval, Cohere rerank, MMR, multi-LLM routing
JWT auth, FastSpring licensing, BigQuery nightly export for AI usage and feedback
outcome: End-to-end SaaS platform with production RAG, metered AI billing, and support ops UI used daily by customers and the support team.

title: RAG knowledge base — internal docs search
lead: Retrieval-augmented search for a B2B SaaS internal documentation library with semantic retrieval and cited answers.
requirements: Make internal docs searchable with natural language, not keyword-only search
Return answers grounded in source documents with citations
Support incremental ingestion as documentation changes
implementation: Document ingestion pipeline: parse, chunk, embed, and index in Pinecone
Search API with top-k retrieval and LLM generation with source attribution
Admin hooks for re-indexing and monitoring retrieval quality
outcome: Internal teams query company docs in plain language and get cited answers from the live knowledge base.

title: Internal copilot — LLM with tools
lead: Internal assistant that answers from company docs and runs approved tools such as Jira and Slack with access controls and audit logging.
requirements: Answer questions using Confluence, Notion, and internal wikis
Execute approved tool calls for ticketing and messaging workflows
Enforce role-based access and maintain an audit trail
implementation: RAG layer over Confluence and Notion with function-calling orchestration
Tool adapters for Jira and Slack with scoped credentials
Access controls, prompt guardrails, and request logging for compliance
outcome: Employees get grounded answers and can trigger approved actions without leaving the chat interface.

title: AI Invoice Bot — OCR + LLM extraction
lead: Upload invoice images or PDFs, run OCR, and use an LLM to extract parties, amounts, and line items into structured data.
requirements: Accept invoice images and PDFs from customers
Extract who owes whom and how much with high accuracy
Return structured JSON suitable for downstream accounting systems
implementation: Tesseract and Google Cloud Vision for OCR preprocessing
LLM parsing pipeline with schema validation and confidence checks
API endpoint and error handling for malformed or low-quality scans
outcome: Manual invoice data entry replaced with automated extraction ready for review and import.

title: LLM training pipeline — code review
lead: Architecture and code review for LLM training pipelines in Python and Docker, focusing on data loading, checkpointing, and production readiness.
requirements: Review training pipeline architecture for scalability and reproducibility
Improve data loading, checkpointing, and recovery patterns
Align with MLOps best practices for containerized training jobs
implementation: Audited Python training code and Docker image build process
Recommended batching, checkpoint strategy, and failure recovery
Documented runbooks for retraining and model artifact versioning
outcome: Training pipeline hardened for repeatable runs with clearer recovery paths and reviewed architecture.

title: GCP Dataflow — Confluent to BigQuery
lead: Kafka to BigQuery streaming pipeline for high-throughput event ingestion with schema validation and dead-letter handling.
requirements: Stream events from Confluent Kafka into BigQuery in near real time
Validate schemas and route bad records to a dead-letter path
Monitor throughput and latency for production SLAs
implementation: Apache Beam pipeline on Dataflow with autoscaling workers
Schema registry integration and DLQ topic for failed records
Cloud Monitoring dashboards and alerting on lag and error rates
outcome: Reliable streaming ingest at scale with observability and a clear path for bad data.

title: Hadoop-to-GCP migration
lead: On-prem Hadoop workloads migrated to GCP with Dataproc and BigQuery, preserving data lineage and operational runbooks.
requirements: Migrate batch and streaming jobs off Hadoop without business disruption
Preserve data lineage and validation between old and new systems
Hand over runbooks so the client team can operate GCP workloads
implementation: Inventory of Hive, MapReduce, and Spark jobs with dependency mapping
Rewrote pipelines for Dataproc and BigQuery with phased cutover
Parallel validation runs and documentation for operations
outcome: Hadoop estate retired on schedule with validated BigQuery targets and full handover docs.

title: ML feature pipeline — training & serving

requirements: Reproducible feature engineering from raw operational data
Orchestrated training runs with versioned models
Low-latency serving API for downstream applications
implementation: Feature store patterns with Airflow orchestration
Model registry integration and promotion gates
REST serving layer with monitoring and rollback support
outcome: Single pipeline from raw data to production predictions with traceable model versions.

Null analysis, correlation detection, and profiling at scale

Governance dashboards and metadata integration for stewards

Meet healthcare data handling and audit expectations
Expose cleansed data via REST for consuming applications

Beadledom REST services for governed downstream access
outcome: Clinical data ready for analytics and applications with controlled REST endpoints.

Reconciliation jobs comparing cache snapshots to authoritative DB
AppDynamics agents and alerting for production incidents
outcome: Faster portfolio reads with automated reconciliation and production-grade monitoring.
